health_verdict.headline: Policy has plateaued 3,627 episodes past its 89.3% rolling peak at 83.82% mean destruction and 34.0% 3-star rate due to a 16.3% inter-village gap on Offset Diamond and a -24.89 pt critic V(s0) under-calibration.
health_verdict.progression_summary: Across 9,084 episodes, the agent reliably secures 1-star (100.0%) and 2-star TH18 takedowns (98.0%), but stalls on the 2-star to 3-star conversion funnel (34.7% conditional conversion, 12.0% near-miss rate in the 85-99% range) with a flat reward slope (-0.068/100ep) despite a mild recent recovery slope (+0.946%/100ep). Performance is heavily dragged down by TH18 Offset Diamond (Hot Candle + Longshot) at 76.0% average destruction and 10.7% triple rate versus 92.3% (42.4% triple rate) on Anti-Hydra Air Ring.

reasons.title: 2-Star to 3-Star Back-End Cleanup Plateau
reasons.symptom: 98.0% 2-star TH18 rate but only 34.0% 3-star triple rate, 12.0% near-miss (85-99%) rate, and -5.5% drawdown from the 89.3% peak over 3,627 episodes.
reasons.root_cause: With high_pct_milestone_75, high_pct_milestone_90, and triple_wipe_bonus all set to 0.0, 48.9% of total reward mass is front-loaded into the 50% star and TH18 takedown, leaving late-battle cleanup actions with weak marginal GAE advantages after the core falls.

reasons.title: 16.3% Inter-Village Destruction Gap on Offset Diamond
reasons.symptom: Worst village Offset Diamond (Hot Candle) averages 76.0% destruction (2.02 stars, 10.7% triple rate) vs 92.3% (2.37 stars, 42.4% triple rate) on Anti-Hydra Air Ring.
reasons.root_cause: Current U-Net FiLM conditioning scale (0.5) and TH18 breach attraction weights (th_threat_weight=6.0, breach_prior_weight=8.0) under-concentrate entry funneling and spell timing through asymmetric diamond compartments guarded by the 6-flame Hot Candle and Longshot.

reasons.title: Critic V(s0) Baseline Lag and Unbalanced Village Sampling
reasons.symptom: Critic V(s0) = 52.91 vs empirical mean reward 77.8 (calibration_gap = -24.89 pts), grad_norm_50 = 40.82, and matchup_mode = random.
reasons.root_cause: Random village sampling combined with critic_lr_mult = 2.5 causes the value head to lag behind multi-modal return distributions across disparate layouts, injecting systematic positive bias and high variance into GAE advantage estimates.

best_village.name: Anti-Hydra Air Ring
best_village.full_name: TH18 Anti-Hydra Air Ring (4 Air X-Bows + Sweepers)

detected_signals.metric: Worst: Offset Diamond (Hot Candle) (76.0%) vs Best: Anti-Hydra Air Ring (92.3%)
detected_signals.detail: 16.3% destruction spread across reference villages indicates the policy struggles to penetrate TH18 Offset Diamond (Hot Candle + Longshot) compartment geometry.
Critic baseline prediction V(s₀) lags empirical episode return or captures low return variance, increasing GAE advantage variance during PPO updates.

candidate_solutions.title: Synergistic Architecture + Milestone Reward + Critic Calibration Upgrade
candidate_solutions.rationale: Combines sharper U-Net TH18 breach conditioning (`th_threat_weight`, `film_cond_scale`), progressive 75%/90%/3★ reward milestones (`high_pct_milestone_75`, `high_pct_milestone_90`), and Critic LR calibration (`critic_lr_mult`, `round_robin` village balance) to simultaneously improve spatial entry, core sustain, and value baseline accuracy.
candidate_solutions.expected_verification_criteria: Simultaneously lift recent 50-ep Destruction %, 2★+ TH18 rate, and worst-village performance.

candidate_solutions.title: High-Destruction Milestone & Core HP Shaping Boost
candidate_solutions.rationale: Adds explicit progressive milestone bonuses at ≥75% (+4.5 pts) and ≥90% (+6.0 pts) destruction plus a +8.0 pt 3★ wipe bonus and elevated Core HP & TH18 takedown weights so GAE advantages strongly reward pushing through the TH18 core into back-end cleanup.
candidate_solutions.expected_verification_criteria: Improve recent 50-ep Mean Destruction % by ≥ +0.5% or increase 2★+ TH18 / 3★ Triple conversion rate.

candidate_solutions.title: U-Net FiLM Conditioning & TH18 Spatial Breach Attraction Amplification
candidate_solutions.rationale: Increases the U-Net decoder's FiLM multiplicative conditioning scale (`film_cond_scale`), strengthens the 15×15 cascaded Town Hall 18 breach attraction field (`th_threat_weight`, `breach_prior_weight`) and mid-battle spell combat focus (`spell_combat_prior_weight`), and tightens spatial tile entropy regularization so troops funnel into a concentrated breach corridor.
candidate_solutions.expected_verification_criteria: Increase Top-5 Tile Probability Mass %, reduce perimeter scatter σ, and improve 2★+ TH18 breach rate.

candidate_solutions.title: Critic Calibration Acceleration, Trust-Region Fine-Tuning & Round-Robin Sampling
candidate_solutions.rationale: Refines actor learning rate for fine-grained late-stage convergence while boosting `critic_lr_mult` and `vf_coef` to eliminate V(s₀) calibration lag, and enforces `round_robin` village sampling so every PPO batch receives equal gradient weight from the hardest TH18 layout.
candidate_solutions.expected_verification_criteria: Reduce inter-village destruction gap, improve Critic Explained Variance, and resume positive destruction slope.

reasons.title: High Cross-Village Performance Gap (17.1% Spread)
